sourceClaims.claim: Offsets, blur, alpha, strokes, and multi-shadow composition are retained per authoritative component source.
Wave 1 exposes no global elevation scale because the source does not establish one.
Nearly equal effects are not normalized across component families.

evidence.source-integrity: pass: overlay source tests trace offsets, blur, alpha, strokes, and multi-shadow composition to the owning component SVGs
evidence.structural-contract: pass: production CSS retains distinct source-backed effect compositions and exposes no unsupported shared elevation token
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: a focused browser assertion resolves the representative notification shadow to rgba(11, 22, 35, 0.1) 0px 4px 15px 0px
evidence.accessibility: not-applicable: audited effects do not carry meaning independently
evidence.focused-visual: pass: focused overlay and notification snapshots exercise the distinct source-backed shadow and overlay compositions
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Showcase and Data Workspace exercise representative notification, field, popover, and modal effects
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: browser tests cover narrow drawer and long modal surfaces without changing or clipping their audited overlay effects

limitations: Effects remain component-local; this manifest verifies the foundation boundary, not the components themselves.
